harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up automated one-way sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2 using a pull-based cron job over SSH, running every 5 minutes (well within the 15-minute requirement). Verified the sync works both via manual invocation and via the actual cron trigger. Then performed the mandatory sequential restart of both nodes and confirmed full recovery of services, cron persistence, and data consistency, including a live post-reboot automated sync test.
actions_performed: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as the source-of-truth inventory app config (it did not previously exist)
Provisioned passwordless SSH between node1 and node2 using the cluster-provided keypair, and populated /etc/hosts on both nodes from CLUSTER_HOSTS

Wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2: pulls /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 via SSH, compares checksums, and only overwrites the local copy (logging via logger) when content differs
Enabled crond and installed a crontab entry on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes (*/5 * * * *)
Verified sync manually (matching sha256sum) and verified automated cron-triggered sync after modifying node1's file (syslog evidence + checksum match)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, crond status, file checksum) on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnection), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified crond active and config data intact post-reboot
Re-verified SSH connectivity and sync functionality from node2 to node1 after node1's reboot before touching node2
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified crond active, crontab persisted, and file checksum matched node1's

Performed a final live end-to-end test: modified node1's file again post-reboot and confirmed the cron job (running natively on schedule, no manual trigger) picked it up and synced node2 to match, per syslog and checksum

evidence.requirement: Passwordless SSH connectivity between nodes established
evidence.summary: Cluster keypair installed on both nodes; SSH from node2 to node1 confirmed working

evidence.requirement: Sync correctness (manual run) — node2 matches node1
evidence.summary: Manual invocation of sync script produced identical sha256sum on node2 as node1

evidence.requirement: Sync picks up changes within 15 minutes via actual cron trigger (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Modified node1's file, polled node2, confirmed cron fired at 13:15:01 (within 3 minutes) and updated file to matching checksum, per syslog log line

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d9f8550d..., crond active, file checksum before reboot

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node2
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 03408ac4..., crond active, crontab entry, file checksum before reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming node1 was down mid-reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 5b3b9e60... (from d9f8550d...) with fresh uptime start, proving actual reboot not just service restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: crond active and /etc/inventory/app.conf checksum intact/unchanged after node1 reboot

evidence.requirement: Sync path health confirmed before restarting node2 (quorum/dependency preserved)
evidence.summary: SSH from node2 to node1 still functional and manual sync succeeded after node1's reboot, before disrupting node2

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id still old on immediate check, then connection timed out confirming reboot in progress

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 39a03212... (from 03408ac4...) with fresh uptime start, proving actual reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of services, cron persistence, and data consistency
evidence.summary: crond active, crontab entry persisted, and file checksum matches node1 exactly after node2 reboot

evidence.requirement: End-to-end automated sync still functions after both restarts, within 15-minute SLA
evidence.summary: Modified node1's file post-reboot; native cron trigger (13:20:02, no manual run) synced node2 to matching checksum within ~4 minutes, confirmed via syslog and sha256sum
